3. Line 21: `int tmp1=debug+1;` - Read operation in main function (part of compound operation)
4. Line 22: `debug = tmp1;` - Write operation in main function (part of compound operation)

The compound operation `debug++` on lines 21-22 decomposes into:
- Read: `tmp1 = debug;` (line 21)
- Write: `debug = tmp1 + 1;` (line 22)
